data.body: Phase 2 RED oracle proven for ferrety-crippling-dairycow. Final held-out test tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_settings_completion.py::test_first_server_construction_completes_mcp_settings is collected (1 node), executes without skip/xfail, and fails in a fresh child interpreter for the exact mechanism: build_server() reaches FastMCP Settings construction at src/rebar/mcp_server.py:627 and exits 1 when IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning is promoted to error. The first draft's Python -W custom-category filter was rejected by the interpreter and therefore falsely green; it was corrected before any production change by importing the category then applying warnings.simplefilter inside the child. CI gate: make test.
